name: fonnte
description: Fonnte WhatsApp gateway (Indonesia): send messages and files, validate numbers, device status and groups; agent sends need an opt-in and an E.164 recipient allowlist

nodes.title: Device profile
nodes.description: The device's number, connection status (connect/disconnect), package, remaining quota and expiry

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Validate numbers
nodes.description: Check which numbers are registered on WhatsApp (needs a connected device)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List groups
nodes.description: WhatsApp groups of the device as last fetched (id ...@g.us and name)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send message
nodes.description: Send a WhatsApp message (text, or a file with caption) to one number; returns message ids and process status (as an agent tool only when FONNTE_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1)

message.description: Text (up to 60000 characters); the caption when file_url is set

file_url.description: Public URL of an image, video, audio or document to send (paid packages only)

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient (documents and audio)

connect_only.description: true (Fonnte default): refuse when the device is disconnected; false: queue

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send group message
nodes.description: Send a WhatsApp message to a group the device is in (id from list_whatsapp_groups)

message.description: Text (up to 60000 characters); the caption when file_url is set

file_url.description: Public URL of an image, video, audio or document to send (paid packages only)

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient (documents and audio)

connect_only.description: true (Fonnte default): refuse when the device is disconnected; false: queue

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete message
nodes.description: Delete a pending or scheduled message (not one that is processing)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Refresh groups
nodes.description: Re-fetch the device's group list from WhatsApp (Fonnte: call rarely, abuse can get the number banned)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Disconnect device
nodes.description: Log the WhatsApp number out of Fonnte (re-linking needs a QR scan)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
